fields.description: Master switch for the HMIS sync agent.
fields.label: Enable HMIS Sync

fields.description: How often to pull new patients/visits/bills. The background scheduler ticks every minute, so this value is rounded up to a minimum of 15 minutes.
fields.label: Poll Interval (minutes)

fields.description: Max records pulled per sync run.
fields.label: Batch Size

fields.description: When the sync agent last actually ran. Updated automatically.
fields.label: Last Run At

fields.options: Direct MySQL connection to the OpenMRS database (Bahmni's standard engine) — a DB-level login from the IT team, separate from any Bahmni application login.
Direct PostgreSQL connection to the Odoo database (Odoo's standard engine) — a DB-level login from the IT team, separate from any Odoo application login.
The sync only fetches records updated after the dates below, and advances them on every successful run. Leave "Sync Records From" blank to import all history on the first run.

fields.description: Last Bahmni patient/visit update timestamp successfully imported. Updated automatically — do not edit manually.
fields.label: Last Bahmni Sync On

fields.description: Last Odoo invoice update timestamp successfully imported. Updated automatically — do not edit manually.
fields.label: Last Odoo Sync On

fields.description: Set automatically on the very first successful sync run.
fields.label: Is First Run

fields.description: Only pull records created/updated on or after this date on the first run. Leave blank to import all history. Ignored on later runs — the watermark above takes over once a run has succeeded.
fields.label: Sync Records From

fields.description: Only pull records on or before this date. Leave blank for no upper bound (keeps pulling new records as they appear). Applies on every run, not just the first.
fields.label: Sync Records To

fields.options: Each Bahmni patient identifier is matched to the Patient Registration record whose field below has the same value, so the same patient is updated rather than duplicated on every run.

fields.description: Fieldname on Patient Registration matched against the Bahmni patient identifier.
fields.label: Match To Patient Registration Field

fields.description: When on, a failure email is sent if a sync run errors.
fields.label: Send Email On Failure
